versions.changelog:
One-Eval Skill 1.0.0: Initial release of an end-to-end evaluation workflow skill for pure-text LLMs.

- Drives One-Eval's deterministic execution core to benchmark LLMs (API or local vLLM) and generate multi-metric, illustrated reports.
- Handles environment detection/setup, model API/vLLM connectivity checks, benchmark/metric selection, full evaluation, scoring, and report rendering via a stepwise process.
- Ensures all user interactions occur in the user's language, with clear confirmation and summarization at each step.
- Requires One-Eval main repository pre-installed; guides users to avoid unnecessary heavy dependencies (like vLLM) unless needed.
- Report process includes: environment check, model connectivity, explicit configuration confirmation, benchmark and metric selection, smoke/test verification, full evaluation, multi-metric scoring, and HTML report output.
